# Qooper

> Qooper is an AI-powered mentoring and people development platform that automates mentor-mentee matching, learning, and talent management for enterprises, universities, and organizations.

Qooper provides comprehensive mentoring solutions with intelligent matching algorithms, integrated learning pathways, and analytics to drive employee engagement, retention, and organizational development. The platform supports diverse use cases including onboarding, leadership development, ERG management, and cross-functional collaboration.

## Key Topics

- AI-Powered Matching
- Mentor-Mentee Matching
- Mentorship Programs
- Smart Matching Algorithm
- Employee Development
- Leadership Development
- Talent Management
- Onboarding Programs
- Learning Platform
- People Intelligence
- Employee Engagement
- Employee Retention
- ERG Software
- Peer Learning
- Multi-Language Support

## Core Mentoring Platform

- [Qooper | AI-Powered Mentoring & People Development Platform](https://www.qooper.io): Qooper homepage: AI-powered mentoring platform with smart matching, training, and reporting.
- [Best Mentoring Software for Easy and Impactful Mentoring](https://www.qooper.io/mentoring-software): Mentoring software with AI matching, training, analytics for companies, universities, associations.
- [Qooper | Organization-Wide Mentoring Programs](https://www.qooper.io/mentoring): Organization-wide mentoring programs with smart matching, Teams/Slack integration, goal tracking.
- [Qooper | Mentor Mentee Matching Software](https://www.qooper.io/mentor-mentee-matching): AI-driven mentor-mentee matching with automated and self-matching options.
- [Qooper | Mentor Matching & Mentoring App](https://www.qooper.io/mentoring-app): Mobile mentoring app with AI matching, chat, feedback, and peer/group connections.

## AI & Intelligent Capabilities

- [Qooper | Qooper AI for Easier and More Impactful Mentoring](https://www.qooper.io/qooper-ai): Qooper AI automating matching, training, guidance, and survey analysis for mentoring.
- [Qooper | People Intelligence](https://www.qooper.io/people-intelligence): Workforce intelligence from mentoring conversations for talent decisions and succession planning.
- [Qooper | Reporting & Analytics](https://www.qooper.io/reporting-analytics): Program analytics tracking engagement, outcomes, ROI, and participant feedback.

## Specialized Programs & Use Cases

- [Qooper | New Hires - Onboarding Buddy Program](https://www.qooper.io/new-hire-onboarding-buddy): Onboarding buddy programs automating new hire mentorship for faster learning and retention.
- [Qooper | High Potential Leadership Program](https://www.qooper.io/high-potential-leadership-program): High-potential talent development via mentoring with learning paths and workshops.
- [Qooper | ERG and Community Programs](https://www.qooper.io/erg-community-programs): ERG and community management with event tools, mentorship, analytics, and integrations.
- [Qooper ERG Software](https://www.qooper.io/erg-software): ERG software for group creation, member connection, mentorship, and event management.
- [Qooper | Groups](https://www.qooper.io/groups): Group mentoring feature for community circles, ERGs, and peer learning with integrations.
- [Qooper | Universities](https://www.qooper.io/universities): University mentoring platform for student peer and alumni mentoring, career outcomes.

## Learning & Development

- [Qooper | Learning](https://www.qooper.io/learning): Next-gen learning platform with courses, mentoring, peer learning, and skill gap analysis.
- [Qooper | Breaking Down Departmental Silos](https://www.qooper.io/break-down-departmental-silos): Cross-departmental mentorship to break silos, foster collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

## Employee Experience & Retention

- [Qooper | Employee Engagement](https://www.qooper.io/employee-engagement): Employee engagement via mentoring and learning for retention and workplace culture.
- [Qooper | Employee Retention](https://www.qooper.io/employee-retention): Retention improvement through mentorship programs with AI matching and measurable ROI.

## Integrations & Global Support

- [Qooper | Integrations](https://www.qooper.io/integrations): Integration documentation for HRIS, calendar, Teams, Outlook, Zoom, LMS, and SSO.
